## ArprtDevice v1alpha1

API: `arprt.dayflower.github.io/v1alpha1` · Scope: `Namespaced` · Resource: `arprtdevices`

ArprtDevice represents one physical device, its assignment and observed state.

### ArprtDevice v1alpha1 spec

ArprtDeviceSpec declares authentication, assignment and desired display overrides.

Validation failure messages:

- at most one of screenRef and playlistRef is permitted
- at most one hardware identity source is permitted
- hardwareID source is immutable; replace the device to change identity
- hardwareIDSecretRef source is immutable; replace the device to change identity

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`authSecretRef`](#arprtdevice-v1alpha1-specauthsecretref) | object | Yes | — | AuthSecretRef names the same-namespace Secret holding the device API key. |
| [`display`](#arprtdevice-v1alpha1-specdisplay) | object | No | — | Display overrides individual resolved capabilities; omitted fields use observations or model profiles. |
| `hardwareID` | string | No | — | HardwareID optionally restricts registration to this canonical uppercase MAC. Maximum length: 17. Format is validated by the schema. |
| [`hardwareIDSecretRef`](#arprtdevice-v1alpha1-spechardwareidsecretref) | object | No | — | HardwareIDSecretRef optionally restricts registration using a Secret value. |
| [`playlistRef`](#arprtdevice-v1alpha1-specplaylistref) | object | No | — | PlaylistRef selects an ordered same-namespace screen cycle. |
| `rotation` | integer (int32) | No | `0` | Rotation requests clockwise content rotation in degrees. Renderers apply it while preserving the physical display dimensions of the output PNG. Allowed: `0`, `90`, `180`, `270`. |
| [`screenRef`](#arprtdevice-v1alpha1-specscreenref) | object | No | — | ScreenRef selects one same-namespace Screen, exclusively with playlistRef. Omitting both references enables name-sorted Screen discovery in this namespace. |

## ArprtPlaylist v1alpha1

API: `arprt.dayflower.github.io/v1alpha1` · Scope: `Namespaced` · Resource: `arprtplaylists`

ArprtPlaylist defines an ordered screen cycle selected by a Device.

### ArprtPlaylist v1alpha1 spec

ArprtPlaylistSpec defines a bounded, explicitly ordered screen cycle.

Validation failure messages:

- renderTimeout is only supported for Skip playlists

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `failurePolicy` | string | No | — | FailurePolicy omitted selects Hold, preserving stale fallback and turn holding. Allowed: `"Hold"`, `"Skip"`. |
| `renderTimeout` | string | No | — | RenderTimeout bounds all candidates from request admission. Skip defaults to 10s. Maximum length: 3. Format is validated by the schema. |
| [`screens`](#arprtplaylist-v1alpha1-specscreens) | array of object | Yes | — | Screens preserves order and repeated names; references stay in this namespace. Minimum items: 1. Maximum items: 64. |

## ArprtScreen v1alpha1

API: `arprt.dayflower.github.io/v1alpha1` · Scope: `Namespaced` · Resource: `arprtscreens`

ArprtScreen defines reusable rendering intent; generated images live outside the CR.

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec

ArprtScreenSpec declares the source and processing policy for a screen.

Validation failure messages:

- refreshInterval must be omitted for HTTP POST
- refreshInterval must be omitted for OnDemand Jobs

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`imageProcessing`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specimageprocessing) | object | No | — | ImageProcessing controls normalization of renderer PNG inputs. |
| [`overlay`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specoverlay) | object | No | — | Overlay controls optional controller bitmap drawing on new deliveries. |
| `refreshInterval` | string | No | — | RefreshInterval controls artifact freshness, not device polling. Effective defaults are 5m for GET and 30m for Scheduled Job; POST/OnDemand have no interval. Validation failure messages: interval must be between 1s and 24h in whole seconds. Maximum length: 32. Format is validated by the schema. |
| [`source`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specsource) | object | Yes | — | Source selects exactly one rendering backend. |

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec.imageProcessing

ImageProcessing controls normalization of renderer PNG inputs.

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dithering` | string | No | `"atkinson"` | Dithering selects palette quantization for inputs that require normalization. Allowed: `"atkinson"`, `"floyd-steinberg"`, `"bayer"`, `"none"`. |
| `resizeMode` | string | No | `"contain"` | ResizeMode fits the complete image with contain or fills the target with stretch. Allowed: `"contain"`, `"stretch"`. |

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec.overlay

Overlay controls optional controller bitmap drawing on new deliveries.

Validation failure messages:

- position must be omitted when cycleCorners is true

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cycleCorners` | boolean | No | `false` | CycleCorners moves the overlay between corners on committed deliveries. |
| `enabled` | boolean | No | `false` | Enabled opts new deliveries into controller-drawn overlays. |
| `items` | array of string | No | — | Items omitted selects all items; an explicit empty array draws nothing. A pointer preserves empty arrays through JSON and Kubernetes round trips. Maximum items: 3. Each item: Allowed: `"timestamp"`, `"battery"`, `"wifi"`. |
| [`margin`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specoverlaymargin) | object | No | — | Margin insets the padded content row from the two edges adjoining the selected corner. The opaque background extends through each inset to the display edges. |
| `position` | string | No | — | Position is defaulted to top-right internally, never by admission. Allowed: `"top-right"`, `"bottom-right"`, `"bottom-left"`, `"top-left"`. |
| `scale` | integer (int32) | No | — | Scale omitted selects automatic scaling using physical dimensions. Minimum: 1. |

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec.overlay.margin

Margin insets the padded content row from the two edges adjoining the selected corner.
The opaque background extends through each inset to the display edges.

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec.source.http

HTTP fetches a PNG over HTTP GET or POST.

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | string | No | `"GET"` | Method selects GET for device-independent images or POST for current Render Context. Allowed: `"GET"`, `"POST"`. |
| `url` | string | Yes | — | URL is operator-controlled; credentials and redirects are not supported. Validation failure messages: renderer URL must be a valid absolute HTTP URL; query semicolons must be percent-encoded. Maximum length: 2048. Format is validated by the schema. |

### ArprtScreen v1alpha1 spec.source.job

Job renders a PNG in a temporary Kubernetes Job.

Validation failure messages:

- mounts must reference a defined input volume
- input mounts must not overlap
- input mounts must not overlap context or output mounts
- mountPath must be unique
- context and image must be distinct files and neither may be an ancestor of the other
- output parent must not be the filesystem root
- output mount must not hide a system directory
- paths must not overlap the reserved artifact root /var/lib/arprt
- output mount must not hide the ServiceAccount secret tree
- timeout is only supported for OnDemand Jobs
- result and image must have the same parent directory
- result must be distinct from context and image files
- default result path must be distinct from context and image files
- default result path exceeds the path length limit

| Field | Type | Required | Admission default | Description / constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contextPath` | string | No | `"/arprt/context.json"` | ContextPath is the read-only Render Context file supplied to the renderer. Validation failure messages: path must be a clean absolute POSIX file path. Maximum length: 512. Format is validated by the schema. |
| `executionMode` | string | No | — | ExecutionMode omitted selects Scheduled. Defaults are normalized internally. Allowed: `"Scheduled"`, `"OnDemand"`. |
| `imagePath` | string | No | `"/arprt/output.png"` | ImagePath is the PNG file collected from the renderer output volume. Validation failure messages: path must be a clean absolute POSIX file path. Maximum length: 512. Format is validated by the schema. |
| [`renderer`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specsourcejobrenderer) | object | Yes | — | Renderer defines the image, command, environment and resources of the renderer. |
| [`state`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specsourcejobstate) | object | No | — | State enables renderer-owned JSON state committed with display delivery. |
| `timeout` | string | No | — | Timeout includes slot waiting, startup, collection and base-image storage. Omission selects 5s for OnDemand; Scheduled has no request timeout. Maximum length: 3. Format is validated by the schema. |
| `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` | integer (int32) | No | — | TTLSecondsAfterFinished controls finished Job/Pod retention from completion. Omission selects 600 seconds. TTL is applied only after durable collection or failure bookkeeping; zero permits immediate cleanup after that point. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 2147483647. |
| [`volumes`](#arprtscreen-v1alpha1-specsourcejobvolumes) | array of object | No | — | Volumes declares same-namespace ConfigMap and Secret input volumes. Maximum items: 16. |
